justification: Frontend analytics-only change: adds a PostHog 'prospector_search' capture fired from the existing search SWR onSuccess callback on /prospector. No DB queries, no API routes, no regulatory logic, no user-facing text touched. Two files: lib/analytics.ts (new track function following the existing track* pattern) and components/prospector/ProspectorClient.tsx (import + onSuccess wiring).
functions: trackProspectorSearch(params) — thin wrapper over posthog.capture('prospector_search', params), same shape as the 7 existing track* functions in lib/analytics.ts
values: Event payload fields read from already-fetched SWR data (data.total_count, data.query_ms) and URL-derived filters (lga_name, zone_codes, heritage, flood_prone, page) — all null-coalesced (?? 0 / ?? null)
queries: N/A — no database queries; reuses the existing /api/lot-search response, no new fetches

break_it.scenario: onSuccess closure captures stale filters — SWR memoises the options object per hook instance, so the event could report the filters from a previous render while data is from the new search
break_it.what_happens: Analytics rows would attribute result counts to the wrong filter combination, silently skewing the funnel data
break_it.repro: Change a filter, inspect the captured event's lga/zone_codes vs the network request body
break_it.how: The component re-renders with new filters before the new searchKey resolves; SWR uses the latest options object at resolution time (options are read per-request, not frozen at mount). keepPreviousData only affects data, not the onSuccess callback identity.

break_it.scenario: PostHog not initialised (e.g. NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY missing in an environment, or capture called before provider init)
break_it.what_happens: posthog-js queues or no-ops captures before init; no crash, but events from that window may be dropped
break_it.repro: Unset the PostHog key in a preview deployment and run a search
break_it.how: posthog-js buffers pre-init captures internally; identical exposure to the 7 existing track* calls already in production (address_search etc.) — no new failure mode introduced

break_it.scenario: Event double-fires on revalidation, inflating search counts vs real user actions
break_it.what_happens: Funnel step counts would overstate engagement, corrupting the launch metrics this exists to measure
break_it.repro: Switch tabs away and back, or trigger a focus revalidation
break_it.how: revalidateOnFocus is false and shouldRetryOnError is false on this hook, so onSuccess fires exactly once per completed search (landing + each filter change) — which is the intended definition of the event

post_merge.secrets: None — uses the existing NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY already configured in Vercel
post_merge.manual_verify: After deploy, run one search on /prospector in production and confirm a 'prospector_search' event with correct lga/result_count appears in PostHog Activity; then build the pageview -> prospector_search funnel insight
